modifier.name: modifier
modifier.description: HCPCS modifier code (2 characters, e.g., TC, 26)

mac.name: mac
mac.description: Medicare Administrative Contractor code (5 digits, zero-padded)

facility_price.name: facility_price
facility_price.description: OPPS cap amount for facility setting in USD

nonfacility_price.name: nonfacility_price
nonfacility_price.description: OPPS cap amount for non-facility setting in USD

row_content_hash.name: row_content_hash
row_content_hash.description: 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of row content per STD-parser-contracts v2.0. Computed from columns in declared order excluding metadata fields.

business_rules: HCPCS codes must be 5 characters (uppercase alphanumeric)
Modifier must be 2 characters if present (uppercase alphanumeric)
Natural key (hcpcs, modifier, mac, locality_code) must be unique per release
storage_note: Prices stored as Decimal(10,2) for exact precision. Canonicalized before hashing for determinism.

changes: BREAKING: Updated schema to match actual OPPSCAP file structure
Removed: opps_cap_applies, cap_amount_usd, cap_method (v1.0 fields not in file)
Added: status, mac, locality_code, facility_price, nonfacility_price
Updated natural keys from (hcpcs, modifier, effective_from) to (hcpcs, modifier, mac, locality_code)
Verified: Prices vary by MAC and locality - both required in NK
Added: Decimal precision (2dp), rounding_mode, scale for hash stability
